fields.ic_name: AMBA AXI / ACE Protocol Specification (ARM IHI 0022E)
interconnect_topology_options_inherited_: Shared address buses and multiple data buses
Multilayer, with multiple address and data buses

ace_specific_integration_components.Point_of_Serialization_POS: An ACE interconnect must include a Point of Serialization (POS) for each memory address — typically the L3 / system-level cache controller or coherency manager. The POS orders all coherent operations to that address so that all observers see the same order.
ace_specific_integration_components.Point_of_Coherency_PoC: The PoC is the location in the memory system that is the master copy of a Non-shareable address. Inner-Shareable and Outer-Shareable addresses use the PoC plus shareability-domain snooping.
ace_specific_integration_components.Snoop_Filter: Optional snoop filter — interconnect may track which masters cache which addresses to suppress unnecessary snoops. Requires WriteBack/WriteClean/Evict to indicate correct AWDOMAIN.
ace_specific_integration_components.ACE_Lite_master_ports: Non-cached ports (DMA / GPU / IO) that issue ReadOnce / WriteUnique / WriteLineUnique without owning a snoop port.
ace_specific_integration_components.Coherency_Manager: Glue logic at the interconnect that aggregates snoop responses, manages PassDirty propagation, and enforces the 5-state cache-line invariants across all cached masters.

interconnect_id_handling_inherited.id_widening: AXI baseline: interconnect appends bits to ARID/AWID for routing.
interconnect_id_handling_inherited.id_routing: Inherited from AXI baseline; ACE adds RACK/WACK to confirm response delivery so the interconnect can drain outstanding snoops safely.

interconnect_ordering_requirements_ace: All transactions with a given AXI ID must remain in order (inherited from AXI).
Snoop responses on CR for a given master must be in the order of snoop addresses on AC for that master.
RACK/WACK must precede issue of new snoops that depend on the completed transaction's coherency state.
Barrier transactions enforce ordering across the named shareability domain (Memory or Synchronization barrier semantics).
interconnect_role_in_ace: Decode transaction address + AxDOMAIN + AxSNOOP -> identify which coherent masters need to be snooped.
Issue snoop on AC channel to each target cached master (excluding the initiator).
Collect CRRESP from each target; aggregate PassDirty/IsShared semantics.
If any target reported PassDirty=1, route the corresponding CD data into the response stream.
Combine snoop-collected data + memory-fetched data + appropriate RRESP[3:2] PassDirty/IsShared.
Wait for RACK from the initiator before issuing further snoops that depend on this transaction's outcome.
Honor barrier transactions: gate downstream coherent traffic until the barrier completes.
Distribute DVM messages to all coherent masters in the named shareability domain.
fields.default_slave_behavior: When the interconnect cannot decode a slave access, it must return DECERR. Recommendation: route to a default slave that returns DECERR.

slave_classification.Memory_slave: Must handle all transaction types correctly.
slave_classification.Peripheral_slave: Has an IMPLEMENTATION DEFINED method of access; non-conforming accesses must complete but functional behavior not guaranteed.
slave_classification.Snoopable_master: A cached master that participates in coherency via AC/CR/CD channels.
slave_classification.Non_snoopable_master_ACE_Lite: Master that issues coherent transactions but does not have AC/CR/CD channels.

interface_categories: Full ACE master (AR/R/AW/W/B + AC/CR/CD + RACK/WACK + AxDOMAIN/AxSNOOP/AxBAR + extended RRESP/BRESP)
ACE-Lite master (AR/R/AW/W/B + RACK/WACK + AxDOMAIN/AxSNOOP/AxBAR + extended RRESP/BRESP, no AC/CR/CD)
AXI4 master (no coherency extensions; can plug into ACE interconnect as an ACE-Lite peer at AxDOMAIN=Non-shareable/System)
Read-only interface (no exclusive, no snoop ownership)
Write-only interface (no exclusive, no snoop ownership)

ace_property_declarations.Cache_Coherent: True if the master maintains a snoop-able local cache.
ace_property_declarations.Supports_DVM: True if the master can process DVM messages (TLB invalidate / BP invalidate / IC invalidate / VA sync).
ace_property_declarations.WriteEvict_supported: True if the master may emit WriteEvict (requires AWUNIQUE).
ace_property_declarations.Snoop_Filter_aware: Interconnect property — interconnect tracks shareable allocations and uses Evict to maintain.
ace_property_declarations.ReadNotSharedDirty_support: Master may decline SharedDirty by choosing ReadNotSharedDirty.

fields.register_slice_insertion_rule: Register slices may be inserted in any AXI channel and in any ACE snoop channel at the cost of an additional cycle of latency. ACE snoop channels follow the same handshake semantics as AXI; insertion preserves correctness as long as ordering of snoops within a master is preserved.
fields.compatibility_with_AXI4_only_masters: An AXI4 master can be connected to an ACE interconnect; the master is treated as ACE-Lite at AxDOMAIN=Non-shareable (no snooping). Conversely, an ACE master can be connected to an AXI4 interconnect by tying off the snoop port and using Non-shareable transactions only.

evidence.quote: The ACE protocol provides hardware cache coherency support and is an extension of the AXI4 protocol.
A shareability domain is a set of masters that enables a master to determine which other masters to include when issuing coherency or barrier transactions.
All snoop transactions are ordered. A response on the snoop response channel must be in the same order as the addresses on the snoop address channel.
A read R1 request must be issued before a read R2 request, where R2 is received after R1, with the same ID and to the same or overlapping locations.
